events.verdict: Holiday (POR) is already in Joe's (OKC) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Clingan (POR) is firming up over his right leg in Joe's (OKC) path and absorbs the contact to his upper body.
Holiday (POR) establishes himself in Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) path and the contact that occurs off-ball is marginal.
Grant (POR) extends his arm into Mitchell's (OKC) back while he is airborne, and initiates contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) steps towards Avdija's (POR) path and the contact that occurs on the perimeter is marginal.
Hartenstein (OKC) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Sharpe's (POR) layup attempt.
Avdija (POR) aligns himself alongside Mitchell's (OKC) path and the contact that occurs during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
Sharpe (POR) and Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Avdija (POR) avoids making contact with Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) arms as he defends the shot near the rim.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects Avdija's (POR) pass attempt.
Camara (POR) commits a take foul on Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC).
Wallace (OKC) commits a take foul on Holiday (POR).
Camara (POR) contests Joe's (OKC) jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with his arm does not prevent him from following through.

Camara (POR) moves into Joe's (OKC) space and initiates contact with his right leg/foot that affects his jump shot attempt.  After communicating with the Replay Center, it was determined the foul occurred prior to the expiration of the game clock, and the game clock was reset to 0.5 seconds.  Additionally, Joe's right foot steps on the 3-point line as he begins his upward shooting motion, and play resumes with Joe shooting two free throws.
Williams (OKC) and Clingan (POR) pursue the rebound and the contact is marginal.
